name: application-donation-progress
title: Donation Progress Card
description: Fundraiser cards showing amount raised versus a goal, a donor count with avatars, and a donate call to action.
useWhen: Fundraiser cards showing amount raised versus a goal, a donor count with avatars, and a donate call to action.
avoidWhen: Avoid donation progress card when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Donation Progress Card uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
